Message:
Since that day,
my brother and I
started our new life together.

But, we lived among the poor.
And as of late,
we haven’t been able to afford
even a single piece of firewood.

That’s why I brought him to
one of the monasteries in town,
believing he’d have
a chance at a better life there.
But...

“No! I wanna stay
with you, Big Sis!”

As we stood
in front of the monastery,
my brother tightly
clutched at my clothes.

I wanna keep
staying with him too,
but I had no way
to make him happy...
So, I told him...

“They have blankets here
that’ll keep you
warm and comfy,
and you won’t have to
be alone ever again.”

I tried to gently pull away
from my brother,
when he threw
his arms around me.

“I don’t need anything
like that, Big Sis!

Just hug me,
and I’ll feel
warm and comfy enough...
You’re all I need—nothing else!”
I feel...the exact same way.

No matter how cold
the nights get,
just curling with him
under a single blanket
was enough to warm my heart...
Ahh, how could I not see that?
We had more than enough.

Curling up alone under a blanket
might warm your body up,
but it’s not enough
to warm your heart.
The only thing that can is...

“I’m so sorry.
You’re all I need, too.
Nothing else.”

I pulled my brother
tightly into my arms.

I will never let go of him again.
I’ll live on, keeping this
tiny bit of happiness safe...
My one and only...treasure.
